scope: Read-only source and installed binary review plus one controlled fake subprocess. No model calls, source changes, or campaign changes.

findings.evidence: Installed error-result schema and structured-output retry exhaustion emission contain usage, modelUsage, total_cost_usd, num_turns, duration_ms and duration_api_ms. Adapter raises on is_error before reading them; engine except stores only status/error.
Runtime control-epoch cancellation branch returns before persisting an available Response usage and elapsed receipt.
Structured-output retry exhaustion reports five internal attempts within a single CLI invocation. Quota counts invocations; auxiliary model usage can also occur.

after_campaign_fix: Collect terminal result telemetry before inspecting is_error. Share normalization between success and failure.
Carry sanitized usage, reported primary identities, elapsed time, output bytes and terminal subtype on ProviderError; persist them in exception receipts.
Persist telemetry from completed but discarded/cancelled proposals without retaining raw proposal content.
Preserve missing telemetry as null with reasons; do not infer costs from five attempts or rerun old trials to backfill.
regression_tests: Error result with usage and modelUsage persists metrics once while remaining failed.
Error result without usage but with modelUsage preserves known aggregate only.
Missing terminal result retains null totals, not zero.
Auxiliary model rows contribute usage without changing primary model identity.
Cancellation after receipt preserves telemetry and executes no proposal.
campaign_handling: Keep frozen source and current raw results unchanged. Report failed-call usage as missing; aggregates are observed usage lower bounds when errors have lost telemetry. Lost terminal records cannot be reconstructed from progress counts.
